links.comparator_used: No head-to-head comparison with point predictions; MC dropout uncertainty maps were assessed against a radiation oncologist's qualitative opinion
links.outcome: Identification of under- or over-contouring in lung tumour CT segmentation, and agreement between uncertainty metrics and clinical opinion
links.effect: Strong correlation between clinical opinion and the MU metric; both MU and RUV showed high AUC values in discriminating low from high uncertainty cases (no numeric values given in the text)
links.tradeoff: The model was overconfident, as shown by the calibration evaluation with reliability diagrams.
links.quote: Our study showed that uncertainty mapping effectively identified cases of under or over-contouring.

design_hint: uncertainty maps to flag cases for clinician visual review
